calibration.note: bytes/4 OVERestimates real o200k_base tokens by ~11% on this corpus (ratio real/est = 0.8932 overall pre-Slice-B); conservative for gating. Pre-Slice-B full instructed load = 268,871 real tokens, still exceeding a 200k window. Slice B wave 1 (this baseline) shrank skill/SKILL.md from 216,112 to 110,797 bytes by replacing the inlined full non-droppable-manual-contract.md with a hot manual-contract-digest.md plus a cold-law-manifest.json binding digest clauses back to the full cold contract by sha256; per-bundle rows are unaffected by this slice.

ratchet._comment_aggregate_tolerance: total-hot-surfaces (the aggregate ratchet row) is gated at this strictly tighter tolerance than tolerance_pct. If it used the same tolerance_pct as per-row checks, growth spread evenly across every per-row surface (each individually still within tolerance_pct) would also land inside tolerance_pct in aggregate, defeating the point of an aggregate check.
ratchet.baseline_ref: codex/v0.4.6.0-runtime-footprint Slice B wave 1: non-droppable-manual-contract digest+cold-law-manifest reduction
ratchet._comment_slice_b: skill-md-only, five-bundle-substantive, always-load-bundles, structural-diagnosis-floor, and total-hot-surfaces are lowered in this change to the newly measured post-reduction values. The compiled root skill/SKILL.md dropped from 216112 to 110797 bytes (54028 to 27699 est_tok) by replacing the inlined full non-droppable-manual-contract.md with a compact manual-contract-digest.md; the full contract now ships cold under skill/references/rubrics/ and is bound back to the digest by skill/cold-law-manifest.json (sha256 per clause). This is a deliberate ratchet-baseline reduction, not banked headroom: per-bundle rows are unchanged.

aspirational.note: Slice A2 activates these after kernel/shard slices land. Recorded for visibility only.

_comment_exclusions: largest-retained-output is intentionally excluded from ratchet.baseline: it measures the size of a retained proof-corpus case output, and it is legal (and expected over time) for retained outputs to grow large as cases accumulate more traversal detail. Gating on it would penalize correct, larger-but-valid outputs, so this row is measured for visibility only and is never enforced by the ratchet.
